notes: `hăḵî` is treated as one fused interrogative frame rendered *Was ... not*, headed on the opening particle under rule 23; the unit note names the competing splits (dividing the two words between the particles, or marking `kî` `unrepresented`). This is the verse's one genuinely open question, since `kî` has no negative sense of its own and rule 30's condition has to be read as one rendering rather than one token.
`min` is rendered *most ... of*, headed on the relational word the ASV actually wrote (rule 24's closing sentences).
The resultative `hāyāh lə` is recast as a passive, so both prepositions are `unrepresented` and the suffix takes *their* (rules 21, 40).
